text:
Maya (PM): Pinging the group for a quick UX decision on the private/VPC setup wizard. Two options in the mocks: (A) compact host rows with inline status and small chevrons, (B) stacked diagnostic cards showing command examples. Need accessibility and scale input. Figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder

Ibrahim (Design): My take: rows are denser for fleets; cards are friendlier for first-time users troubleshooting. Suggest rows by default + an opt-in 'Expand all failed' toggle that turns rows into cards for debugging.

Clara (Eng): Rows with expand-to-card sounds good. Implementation note: keep probes async and show per-row "last checked" timestamps so ordering confusion is minimized. Also include a tiny spinner when a retry is in-flight.

Jo (A11y): Accessibility checklist: rows must be reachable with keyboard and announce state changes. Use aria-expanded on the row if it's expandable, and have an aria-live polite region for scan completion only. Avoid announcing every single host status change.

Maya (PM): Copy question: current status labels are 'Reachable', 'Unreachable', 'Timeout', 'Port closed'. Thoughts on phrasing—should we soften 'Unreachable'?

Ibrahim (Design): Change 'Unreachable' to "Can't reach host" — more conversational and less blaming. For buttons use verbs: 'Retry probe', 'Show logs', 'Copy command'.

Clara (Eng): Also propose a per-host tiny "Why this fails" link that shows 1-2 likely causes and an example command (e.g., `nc -vz <HOST> <PORT>`). Make raw logs hidden behind 'Show logs' to avoid noise.

Jo (A11y): When expanding details, move focus into the details panel and focus the first interactive control (Retry). ESC should collapse the panel. For the 'Why this fails' content, use a dialog or region with role=region and accessible title.

Maya (PM): UX for bulk actions: hide 'Retry all failed' in a dropdown to avoid accidental mass retries. If used, show a confirmation and enforce cooldowns (max 3 attempts per host) so we don't hammer devices.

Clara (Eng): Cooldown UI: show 'Retry disabled — try again in 30s' tooltip and display 'Last tried: 45s ago' in the row. Server-side we already enforce backoff; mirror it in the client.

Ibrahim (Design): Visuals: avoid full-screen red banners. Use a compact top summary: 'Checks complete — 4 reachable, 2 need attention' with amber icon when partial failures and green for all good. If user clicks 'Show failures only' filter, then surface cards.

Jo (A11y): For live announcements, only read the final summary when probes finish and when user triggers retry results. Avoid noisy updates. Also ensure color isn't the only indicator: include icons and text always.

ci-bot: preview build deployed -> https://deploy/preview/7890 (staging)

Maya (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll update the mocks to: default dense rows, expand-to-card details, per-row last-updated, small "Can't reach host" copy, per-host 'Why this fails' help, and cooldown indicators. Will post updated figma + preview link when available.

Clara (Eng): One small ask: make the copy button for commands unobtrusive (icon-only with accessible label 'Copy command for <HOST>').

Ibrahim (Design): Noted. Also will add tooltip text for truncated hostnames: full hostname on hover.

Maya (PM): Great. Tagging @support for potential KB updates and @design for final accessibility check. Follow-up when updated artifacts are up.
